asr.full_text: While everyone's distracted by Donald Trump over in the US with the tariffs, Stellar XLM is making moves that could change everything. Financially. And no ones paying attention. I'm not going to tell you what's coming quite yet but by the end of this video, you'll know EXACTLY how XLM is a huge part of the future of finance… So forget about meme coins and let's learn about a crypto that is actually going to be used. Because crypto in 2025 is probably the biggest opportunity you will get as an investor in your lifetime. Part One – The Shift To Utility 2023 and 2024 we are all about Bitcoin and mean coins. I like Bitcoin. I think it is a really good hedge against inflation, similar to Gold. But mean coins are not for me, ill leave that there, because I feel crypto is done with hype only narratives. We are entering the utility era, the phase where only the strongest, most real-world ready projects are going to get you them huge returns, us investors are all looking for and Stell Stella is leading that transition. The Stella development foundation just announced that their network is featured complete not for the month, not for the yeah, for the next decade. That means the infrastructure is done, solid, battle tested, ready for mass scale. While other chains are still tinkerin, Stella is ready to launch products that can millions even billions of users they've spent ten years building now it's time to reap the rewards just to be transparent I don't actually have any Xelem Xelem was one of the I saw two zero zero two two compliant coins and this among other things means the banks can use this technology I do have XRP and Hedera which are also applying points, and this among other things, means the banks can use this technology. I do have XRP and the Deera, which are also I so compliant and you can see exactly why below description part to big players are already in one to know what separates hype from substance. The word is adoption and Stella has some serious giant back in it. Franklin Timberland, one of the world's largest asset managers chose Stella to tokenized US government securities Why because of excellence advanced features like the clawback function, which gives institution security and compliance options They need wisdom tree another huge financial player built their tokenized investment app directly on Stellar pack Sauce is bringing its USD stable coin to Stella and let's not forget money Graham who are a remittance Giant building crypto to cash floors using Stellar rails Master Card Partnerships EU regulatory alignment and more are coming. These aren't just promises, they are live integrations. XLM has already been used in serious financial infrastructure. I've been reading a lot lately about the future of Finance. Basically doing everything I can to follow up the money. And ISO 20022 coins keep coming up time and time again. The question is, have you got any exposure to the ISO coins? Let me know in the comments below before we move on I'm all about taking profits this year it's so important if you want my crypto cheat sheet type yes below in the comments part three pay5 a defy gamechanger PayFi is short for Payment Finance and is one of the most exciting things happening in DeFi. It merges blockchain payments with on chain financing and tokenized real world assets RWA's. By the way I think RWA is going to be HUGE over the next few years. My main RWA crypto is H- and you can find out exactly why below. Anyway, Imagine being able to use your income stream, your Pay Slip or Pay Check over in the US as collateral to get loans, right on blockchain. That's what Payfai enables. This opens up financial access to millions of unbanked people worldwide. No credit score, no centralize gatekeepers just real world assets real value and programmable finance on a global scale pay 510 every use into their own bank it's the way d5 was always meant to be and the XL network is making it happen Part four the numbers don't lie let's talk metrics because hype gets people interested yes but for me you've got to go a little bit deeper as i always say you've got to focus on education you've got to do the research now in q4 2024 stellar report 9 million plus total addresses 458 million dollars in real world assets supply as i said adio is going to be huge 19.1 billion in payment volume 57 million plus operations 5.93 second average alleged close time 18 billion plus network transactions this isn't just some rubbish chain built on fresh air this is a rapidly grown financial ecosystem with traction across retail enterprise and institutional levels and stellar isn't just growing it's scaling smart contracts as well soroban is already powering d5 protocols like blend which just crossed 15 million in tvl total value locked this is momentum that's hard to ignore part five ready for regulation and global scale regulation is common that's not a debate anymore it's a fact and while most chains gracing for impact stella is leaning in many people see regulations as negative personally I dawned don't get me wrong Gensler and other members of the SEC in previous years were a definite negative but the new crypto friendly SEC is different and we need regulations because otherwise it would be absolute madness. Stellar are already aligned the EU's MICA regulations, updating sustainability metrics, publishing open compliance data and preparing for real-world financial integration. This is massive for 2 reasons One, it positions Stellar as a legit player in global financial markets and two it makes XLM a safer bet for institutions who need regulatory clarity By the way if you are not sure what stellaXLM actually is its an Open Source, Decentralized Payments Network It uses blockchain technology to allow users to transfer funds quickly and at very low costs. Think of it this XRP will be used by the big boys the big institutions for things like cross border payments. XLM will be used by retail investors or customers like me and you and they're not just building tech – they're building a compliant global financial foundation.. Part 6 So why is XLM still sleeping?? With all this, why isn't XLM sky rocking?? Because most of this adoption is QUIET, strategic, long term sellers growth is coming from institutions and enterprises not ex influencers or maincoin whales. The next wave of adoption isn't going to be retail chasing pumps, its going to be big brands. Global banks, and real users onboarding millions of people who wont even know they're using crypto. That's the secret, when the tech disappears into the background. Adoption explodes and Stellar is built to scale quietly, but impact massively. Plus you've had Trump's tariffs and other things going on at a macro level that has suppressed the full market. If you want to know exactly what's going on at a macro level, and you need to be looking at things like Global M2 Money Supply, the Ice M Manufacturing Index, technical indicators, and things like Global M2 Money Supply the ISM manufacturing index, technical indicators and things like the fear and greed index Now if you're not quite sure of what I've just said then you need that bit of support so you can make money & then take profits this year see below & you'll find the link to my crypto community over on School all I'll say is you won't regret joining our awesome community and its risk-free because you get a 7 day free trial Part 7 The Big Picture so try and zoom out what does all this mean it means XLM isn't just another altcoin it's the digital backbone for the next evolution of Global Finance or a huge part of it at least. Some of the better channels that talk about ISO 200022, tend to talk about XRP and XLM together. I'm not fully up to speed with how they are linked but I'm hugely bullish on both cryptos. What would you go for, by the way. XRP or XLM... Let me know below. Anyways, seeing as all this video is all about XLM. Look I will carry on telling you all about XLM. It has Realtoktion. Big partnerships. Regulation. Smart contract expansion. Reall-world DeFi infrastructure. A feature complete, scalable blockchain. And a laser focus on both retail and institutional use cases. The stage is set. The foundation is built and the bull run it's coming fast don't be shocked when xlm starts showing up on top gamer lists because the smart money is already positioning quietly early and confidently summary so are you sleeping on xlm or are you ready to catch one of the biggest moves of this bull cycle let me know in the comments are you holding XLM are you bullish bearish or neutral let me know basically get in the comments and let's start a conversation all about XLM or whatever cryptos you are investing in hit the like button hit the subscribe all the good stuff and again join the community it's risk free and I believe my eight years experience will help you in 2025 in that community thanks for watching good luck
